text:
maggie: Heads up — opened a PR with an end-to-end network example + a tiny smoke test for the Private/VPC installer. Would appreciate quick eyeballs on KMS/HSM port notes and the air-gapped bundle wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 

sanjay: taking a look now. quick Q — in the snippet you list 5698/udp for the HSM heartbeat. our HSM vendor uses 5698/tcp. which one should docs recommend? :eyes:

ben: IIRC installer expects TCP. past staging runs used TCP. pasting the minimal ports stanza I used in staging: 

```yaml
ports:
  - name: kms-api
    port: 443
    proto: tcp
  - name: hsm-control
    port: 5698
    proto: tcp
  - name: metrics
    port: 9090
    proto: tcp
```

maggie: thanks — updated the PR to tcp-only and added a short note about NAT loopback gotchas for on-prem NAT setups. also added a one-line conn-checker command for the smoke test: `curl -sSf http://localhost:8080/health` :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: Lint result: OK. Broken links detected: 1 (will open issue if not fixed in next commit). CI: pending.

eli: small nit for airgap section — call out that the `--offline-bundle` path length must be <= 256 characters on some filesystems. a customer hit this with long S3 key prefixes.

maggie: good catch — added that note and an example path (`/opt/offline-bundles/redwood-2026-01.tar.gz`). also changed the phrase to "offline bundle tarball" to match styleguide.

sanjay: LGTM from KMS side after tcp change. one security nit: don't say "allow all egress" — recommend explicit allowlist. suggested wording: "allowlist rdw-inference-updates.redwood.ai:443 and registry.redwood.ai:443 for installer downloads".

maggie: will update wording. also — can someone run the smoke test on a semi-airgapped VM (no direct internet but with bundle mirror)? @ben can you run it on the staging VM tonight? :pray:

ben: yep I can run it tonight. quick question: does the conn-checker require `net.ipv4.ip_forward=1` on the host? I thought that's only needed for DNAT scenarios.

eli: not needed for the basic smoke test — only for NAT/DNAT forwarding where we're testing cross-host DNAT. add a short note.

ben: run results (staging VM, ubuntu-22, installer v0.12.3):

```
[2026-02-14T02:12:10Z] installer: start
[2026-02-14T02:12:45Z] kms: connection OK
[2026-02-14T02:12:50Z] hsm: handshake OK
[2026-02-14T02:13:00Z] healthcheck: http://localhost:8080/health -> 200
SMOKE TEST: PASS
```

ben: one minor flake — initial curl to the mirror returned 503 once, retried and succeeded. logs attached in the PR.

maggie: amazing, thanks. I'll update the allowlist wording, add the ip_forward note, and merge after CI green. filing a follow-up to add annotated screenshots for the connection-checker run (issue #4824). :tada:

sanjay: thanks everyone. feel free to @me if HSM vendor wording needs further tightening. :+1:

maggie: merging in ~30m if CI stays green. cc @eli for the airgap path note verification.
